scope: Byte-preserving copy, read-only filesystem/hash/Git inspections and static documentation/dependency checks only. Fresh executable validation is separately pending.

limitations: Stage 4 and Stage 5A contain no historical whole-directory manifest or detached seal; their available per-body summary bindings are checked, and package hashes inventory all remaining bytes without inventing historical certification.

repositoryHistoricalIntegrity.scope: Repository artifact-bundle manifest file/hash bindings and every retained detached checksum are checked. Historical whole-release manifests/seals describe older source/build/doc snapshots; they are preserved as records and are not recertifications of current source, current documentation or the selected later qualified build.

dependencyReview.method: Static inspection of every root package script, declared/locked direct dependency, literal imports and import.meta.url references in current source/tests/scripts/build/configuration; no project module loaded or command executed.

scriptChecks.name: test:operations
scriptChecks.command: vitest run test/operations-config.test.ts test/operations-storage.test.ts test/operations-lifecycle.test.ts test/operations-transports.test.ts --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile.json=evidence/phase5/operations-tests.json

documentedLimitations: node_modules is intentionally absent. Declared dependencies and lockfile are present; installation and fresh executable validation remain pending.
The Node engine declaration is >=22.18.0; the preserved qualification is for Node 24.14.1 / SQLite 3.51.2, not every declared runtime.

Wrangler is not a pinned project dependency and was unavailable in the recorded Cloudflare preparation. Its local scheduled-handler/dry-run/provider-runtime validation remains pending; no replacement dependency or nested manifest is invented.
scripts/a3-validate-deployment.py uses Python standard-library TOML support; a compatible Python runtime is an external prerequisite, not a bundled project dependency.

Deployment examples contain operator-supplied host paths and secret names. render.yaml retains an older proposal comment stating its later-implemented entrypoint/configuration did not yet exist; both referenced files are now included, without altering that historical draft.
Historical evidence/release scripts retain their original roots, command lines, inputs and time-dependent assumptions. Static package path checks do not qualify their execution after relocation.
Computed runtime/output paths, temporary test fixtures and environment-provided configuration are not executable-validated. Their current source and required local fixtures are preserved.

documentationReviewBeforeCopy.method: Read-only Markdown inline/reference/HTML path and GFM-style heading/line-anchor inspection. Fenced code is excluded. External URLs are recorded without access. Historical .md.original bytes are reviewed through their explicit original-repository-context relocation map.

earlierParserDiagnostic.correction: The standalone path inspector now recognizes the package root (.) as a valid directory. The sole initial diagnostic was test/fixtures/runtime.ts new URL(../.., import.meta.url), which resolves to the included project root. No repository or evidence defect was found, and no original input changed.

checksumEnvelope: SHA256SUMS.txt lists every payload file except itself. Its own hash and every payload hash are recorded in audit/package-tree.json and the enclosing COMPLETE-SHA256SUMS.txt, which also binds the ZIP and completion report. The outer COMPLETE-SHA256SUMS.sha256 binds that outer inventory; the two outer checksum-envelope files do not self-hash.
